title.rendered: Best USB-C to HDMI cables for Mac in 2026

content.rendered:
Technology has pushed us towards an ecosystem that demands more value against less effort. The notion stands true regarding our iPhones, iPad, and Macs. Luckily, your USB-C port on Mac can help you put your device to multiple uses. For instance, you can connect your Mac to TVs or projectors and enjoy a big-screen experience.  And to do that, you need a type-C to HDMI cable.

A single cable can help you stream your Mac content on external display screens while ensuring high-definition video and audio quality. Currently, you can find multiple offerings in this category, but how to find the best pick?   

To help you, I have curated this list featuring the best USB-C to HDMI cables for Mac. Each product listed here has premium quality, cost-efficiency, and work capabilities.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Anker USB-C to HDMI cable – Editor's Choice
  • 2. QGeeM – Best for HD Audio and Videos
  • 3. Maxonar – 8K resolution for flawless display
  • 4. Anker 8K HDMI cable – Braided nylon exteriors for improved strength
  • 5. JSAUX – Best Quality USB-C to HDMI cable
  • 6. Manifun – Smooth signal transmission
  • 7. Xumee – Multiple device connectivities
  • 8. OseTub – Perfect companion for movie nights
  • 9. CableCreation – Perfect for Office Presentations

1. Anker USB-C to HDMI cable – Editor’s Choice

With Anker’s premium quality assurance, this USB-C to HDMI cable grabs top points for its outstanding picture quality and audio output. With this product, connecting your Mac to the latest computers, TV screens, or a bigger display is a cakewalk. Apart from this, it even works smoothly with Thunderbolt 3. Now, that’s a big win, right? 

With up to 4K@60Hz resolution support, you get the best viewing experience every time. Moreover, the cable has a double-braided nylon exterior and rust-safe aluminum alloy connectors. Using nylon ensures your cable is safe from getting tangled or scratched, whereas aluminum connectors facilitate heat dissipation. Also, enjoy seamless plug-and-play up to 10,000 times with this Anker product.   

Trusted by over 55 million customers globally, Anker always delivers when it comes to quality and performance. You can trust Anker’s USB-C to HDMI cord to access high-definition video quality and smooth audio whenever you use it to extend the display. The cable works well with 16″ MacBook Pro 2020, 15.4″ MacBook Pro 2016-2019, 13.3″ MacBook Pro 2016-2020, MacBook Air 2018-2020, and many other devices.   

Pros

  • Seamless compatibility with multiple devices  
  • Offers 4K@60Hz resolution  
  • Nylon, double-braided cable 
  • Excellent customer support   

Cons

  • Seldom heating at the HDMI port

Check out on Amazon 

2. QGeeM – Best for HD Audio and Videos

Add an extra layer of connectivity to your Mac with this amazing USB-C to HDMI cable from QGeeM. It’s a simple plug-and-play device without a third-party driver/software. The ports offer 4K@30Hz resolution support to stream your favorite sports championships and movies, play e-games, or view photos on big screens. Make the best use of the clamshell mode using this cable on your MacBook and MacBook Pro.   

You can drive one or two HDMI monitors, projectors, TVs, etc., and transfer videos and audio within seconds. Throw away all your Wi-Fi casting issues with this USB-C to HDMI cable. This Type C to HDMI cable comes in a compact and handy design. It is lightweight and carries a non-slip grip structure for smooth plugging and unplugging. Unfortunately, the cable only works in one direction. So, you must connect the USB-C port of your Mac to an HDMI-enabled device.  

The braided nylon exterior adds to the cable’s durability, while the aluminum casing helps avoid heating issues. Also, the tin-plated copper wires and gold-plated terminals offer the best electrical conductivity. Tangled wires or abrasion will never be an issue here as the cable can proudly complete 11,000+ cycles in the bending test.   

You can use this cable with MacBook Pro 2018/2017/2016, MacBook 2017, 2016/2015, iMac 2017, and many others. It has compatibility only with USB-C 3.1 or Thunderbolt 3 port interfaces supporting ‘DisplayPort Alternate Mode.’

Pros

  • Thunderbolt 3 compatible 
  • 4K@30Hz resolution 
  • Multiple device compatibility 
  • Supports clamshell mode   

Cons

  • Only works with USB-C 3.1 or Thunderbolt 3 port with DisplayPort Alt Mode  
  • Cannot be converted to DVI or VGA 

Check out on Amazon 

3. Maxonar – 8K resolution for flawless display

Maxonar’s USB-C to HDMI Cable brings you the powerful combination of the next-gen HDMI 2.1 standard and USB-C. With up to 8K@30Hz UHD resolution support, this USB-C to HDMI cable is perfect for all your audio/visual expeditions. It instantly builds a connection between video-enabled USB-C devices and HDMI devices with DisplayPort Alt Mode.  

The 6ft long cable has a premium braided exterior, increasing its durability and saving the product from abrasion. Triple shielding and 30AWG copper wires protect the cable against heat. Moreover, you get optimum electrical conductivity with aluminum casing and gold-plated connectors. This, in turn, gives high-speed data transmission without flickers.  

One of the best features of the USB-C to HDMI cable is its seamless compatibility with Dynamic HDR. Yes, you read that right. Dynamic HDR compatibility ensures you can access your videos with perfect brightness, contrast, depth, detail, and better color palettes. In addition, you get access to the Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM), which offers a lag-free gaming flow.   

The USB C to HDMI cable works well with your laptop’s USB 4 and Thunderbolt 4/3 ports. Switch to this cable if you are using iMac 27″/24″/21.5″ (2021/2020), MacBook Pro M1 16″/14″/13″ (2021-2017), MacBook Air (2020-2018), iPad Pro (2021-2018), Mac Mini M1(2020), and others.   

Pros

  • Up to 8K@30Hz resolution support 
  • Compatible with Dynamic HDR, USB 4, Thunderbolt 4/3 
  • Lag-free smooth connectivity 
  • High durability and heat resistance 

Cons

  • Cannot charge 
  • Cannot be converted to DVI or VGA 

Check out on Amazon 

4. Anker 8K HDMI cable – Braided nylon exteriors for improved strength

Regarding charging technology, Anker stands out from the league with its innovative and progressive products. For instance, consider this robust type-C to HDMI cable that offers some of the best connectivity features for your Mac. In addition, the cable provides support for 8K@60Hz and 4K@120Hz resolution.

Be it your 4K or 8K content, Anker’s Ultra High-Speed 2.3 HDMI port will handle everything swiftly with its 48 Gbps bandwidth. The cable is a one-stop solution for accessing advanced audio and HDR video formats like Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, Dynamic HDR, etc. The ultra-durable nylon and carbon steel connectors allow you to plug/unplug the cable over 10,000 times without a single strain.   

Anker always satisfies its customers when it comes to quality. This Type-C to HDMI cable is not an exception. The superior quality gold connector pins used here eradicate the issue of screen flickering. Also, high-density EMI shielding stops the cable from interfering with your devices.   

If you are an e-game lover, get ready to enjoy one of the best sessions with Anker’s USB-C to HDMI cable. Some of the features credited to this cable are no lags, screen juddering, or pixel tearing. In addition, functions like Variable Refresh Rate and Quick Media Switching adjust the quality of your content automatically. Also, this cable blesses you with a highly interactive gaming experience with the Auto Low Latency Mode and Quick Frame Transport.   

Pros

  • Supports 8K@60Hz and 4K@120Hz resolution 
  • 48 Gbps bandwidth 
  • Lag-free gaming experience 

Cons

  • Audio issues might arise 
  • Connectivity problem with 4k@60Hz resolution  

Check out on Amazon 

5. JSAUX – Best Quality USB-C to HDMI cable

Are you looking for a cable that supports high-end connectivity and fits your budget? Then your search ends here. Directly cast the screen to the TV or projector from your Mac in seconds without any driver or software. An unstable Wi-Fi will never be a hassle for you.  

Infused with tinplate implantation technology and anti-interference, JSAUX gives the best quality assurance setup to customers. Notably, wear-and-tear, bending, and abrasion are common in wire cables. But if you use JSAUX cable, you don’t have to worry about these damages. However, the cable does not support HDMI to USB-C connectivity. 

The unique strain relief design of the cord can bear over 15,000 bends without any issues. So, it won’t break or tear apart even if you ever plan to play tug-of-war with it. Its aluminum casing adds points to its durability and tensile strength. The nylon braided cable will give you a smooth work experience for a long time. This cable is compatible with devices carrying DP-Alt mode USB-C port.   

Pros

  • Available in multiple lengths
  • Backward support for 1080P, 1080I, and 720P is available 
  • Braided nylon cord gives strength

Cons

  • TV screen flickering is reported by some users 
  • Not bi-directional 

Check out on Amazon 

6. Manifun – Smooth signal transmission 

The need to display content on a bigger screen can be easily met with Manifun’s powerful USB C to HDMI cable. This cable offers 4K@30Hz HD resolution and lets you connect your Mac to more extensive displays like TVs, projectors, and monitors. Use this cable to stream live events, shows, sports events, presentations, etc., on a big screen and bring your family together for a fun night.  

There is no quality compromise in this USB to HDMI cable by Manifun. While premium aluminum wrap ensures adequate heat dissipation, the gold-plated connectors and three-layered cord shielding boosts signal transmission.

Further, you get high-definition graphics and smooth audio every time you play content using this cable, even if your Wi-Fi connection ditches you. In addition, the nylon braided outer cover ensures extra care from wear and tear. Added tensile strength saves the cable from fraying, twisting, or heating.  

The USB-C to HDMI cable is fully compatible with all USB-C products with video output support, DP Alt Mode, Thunderbolt 3 and 4, and USB-C 3.1 Gen 2 or more. All this makes it a perfect companion for MacBook Pro 2016-2022, MacBook Air 2018-2022, iMac 2017-2021, Mac Mini 2018/2020, and more.  

Pros

  • High-quality cable  
  • Aluminum housing avoids heating issues 
  • 24*7 customer support from Manifun

Cons

  • Not preferred for long-term use

Check out on Amazon 

7. Xumee – Multiple device connectivities

Xumee’s USB-C to HDMI cable will let you upgrade to an advanced audio/video experience. With a transmission speed of up to 48Gbps, the cord will likely enhance how you play content on big screens. Ideal resolution up to 7680×43220 coupled with a refresh rate of 8K@30Hz is enough to boost the connectivity of your Mac. Moreover, the cord leverages support for 3D videos, HBR3, Dynamic HDR, and HDCP 2.2.   

The braided nylon cover ensures that you can use the cord the way you want without facing any damage. Its aluminum housing and gold-plated connectors resolve heating issues and provide easy electricity flow even after long hours of continuous work. Plug or unplug the cable as many times as you want with ease.  

If you are a game lover, you will love this USB-C to HDMI cable. The product enhances your gaming experience by supporting Variable Refresh Rate (VRR), Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM), Ultra HD streaming, QFT, etc. Regarding compatibility, this USB-C to HDMI 2.1 cable works well with devices housing Thunderbolt 3 and 4 ports and DP Alt Mode.  

Pros

  • High-quality video streaming up to 8K@30Hz 
  • Ideal for e-gamers 
  • Multiple device support, including Mac, iPad Pro, Mac Mini, etc. 

Cons

  • Screen flickering observed at maximum optimization 

Check out on Amazon 

8. OseTub – Perfect companion for movie nights

The USB-C to HDMI cable created by OseTub comes packed with a plethora of quality features. Strong aluminum casing and braided nylon cover ensure optimum heat dissipation. Also, the nylon covering keeps your cord free from tangles and safe from getting worn out. Thus, high on durability. With gold-plated connectors, you get high-speed data transmission with better resistance to interference. 

Connect your USB-C laptops to HDMI-supported displays using OseTub’s 10-ft long USB-C to HDMI cable in seconds. With up to 4K@30Hz resolution support, the cord lets you transfer audio and video content on HDMI-equipped TVs, monitors, and projectors. You don’t need a separate driver, software, or external power source to use this cord. No extra expenses!  

Pick this cable to relish a smooth, high-definition audio/video experience. The cord is ideal for watching movies, streaming gaming events, displaying your iPhone photos and videos, holding conferences in your home office setup, etc. In addition, you can use the cable for MacBook, MacBook Pro, iPad Pro, Mac Mini, iMac, and others.   

Pros

  • 10-ft long cord for easy usage 
  • 4K@30Hz resolution support 
  • Nylon covering boosts durability 

Cons

  • Not for file transfer or charging 
  • 4K@30Hz resolution necessary for both output and input devices 
  • Works only in one direction 

Check out on Amazon 

9. CableCreation – Perfect for Office Presentations

Do you know you don’t have to go out to enjoy a theatre-like movie experience? With CableCreation’s USB-C to HDMI cord, you can enjoy eye-catching 4K@60Hz videos right from the comfort of your couch. Yes, you read it right. This amazing product offers instant connectivity to your USB Type-C-enabled products with HDMI-supported devices.   

The cable is fully compatible with Thunderbolt 3 and Thunderbolt 4, which eventually makes it a multipurpose choice for users. Feel free to switch between the mirror mode or expand mode using this robust cord and enjoy superior quality audio/video streaming every time. You can use this cable to organize office conferences, learn lessons, display PPTs, play games, and watch movies. 

CableCreation’s USB-C to HDMI cord works well with 2017/2016/2015 MacBook, 2021/2020/2019/2018/2017/2016 MacBook Pro M1, 2021/2020/2018 MacBook Air M1, iMac 2017/iMac Pro, Mac Mini M1/2018. It also works seamlessly with iPad Pro M1 2021/2020/2018.   

Pros

  • Compatible with Thunderbolt 3 and 4 
  • High-quality 4K@60Hz resolution 
  • Ideal for office purposes 

Cons

  • Not for charging 
  • Not compatible with iPhone 

Check out on Amazon 

Wrapping up!

The news about USB-C cables giving direct HDMI output broke out in 2016, and things have never been the same since then. A single USB-C to HDMI cable lets you extend or mirror the display of your Mac to a TV, monitor, and projector. The list mentioned above elaborates such plug-and-play Type C to HDMI cables that offer 4K resolution at budget-friendly prices. I hope you will find your favorite pick from the multiple options given here.  

I will be happy to know about your views on these USB-C to HDMI cables for Mac in the comments section here. Do share your thoughts! 

FAQs

Is it better to use HDMI or a component cable?  

HDMI cables are a better option because you get audio and video support in a single cable. Moreover, it supports multiple products, offers HD quality, and has better future compatibility.  

Do you lose quality with USB-C to HDMI adapter? 

No, you do not lose quality with a USB-C to HDMI adapter. Though, you must ensure that the display supports the correct HDMI specifications.

title.rendered: Best MacBook Air (M4) Accessories You Can Buy in 2026

content.rendered:
Your new M4 MacBook Air is a powerhouse of productivity, but the right accessories can take it to the next level! So, I’ve scoured the internet to find the best cases, screen protectors, ergonomic stands, and high-speed hubs—all compatible with MacBook Air models. Here are my top must-have accessories to complement your new M4 MacBook Air.

Table of Contents
  • Essential factors to consider when choosing MacBook Air accessories
    • 1. Compatibility: Ensure a perfect fit for your MacBook Air
    • 2. Functionality: Boost your productivity and comfort
    • 3. Portability: Keep your MacBook Air safe on the go
    • 4. Durability: Invest in high-quality accessories
    • 5. Budget: Find the right balance between cost and value
    • 6. Aesthetics: Personalize your MacBook Air experience
  • 10+ Must-have accessories for M4 MacBook Air
    • Best MacBook Air cases for ultimate protection
    • MacBook Air screen protectors to shield your display
    • Best sleeves and bags for carrying your MacBook Air safely
    • MacBook Air stands to boost ergonomics and desk organization
    • Connectivity needs – Chargers, USB hubs, and docks
    • Additional accessories for creatives and professional

Essential factors to consider when choosing MacBook Air accessories

When investing in accessories for your M4 MacBook Air, it’s important to choose products that fulfill your needs and enhance your everyday experience. Here are the key factors to keep in mind.

1. Compatibility: Ensure a perfect fit for your MacBook Air

One of the biggest mistakes people make when buying MacBook Air accessories is overlooking compatibility. Apple has updated the MacBook Air’s size, so an accessory that fits the M1 model may not work with the latest M4 version. This is especially important when purchasing protective gear like cases and screen protectors.

2. Functionality: Boost your productivity and comfort

MacBook Air is designed for convenience, but some accessories can make your work experience more comfortable. If you frequently work at a desk, an adjustable laptop stand like the Lamicall laptop stand riser can improve your posture and reduce neck strain.

Professionals may also get a USB hub and external SSD like the SanDisk portable SSD to expand connectivity and storage space. So, think about what you need most from your MacBook Air and choose accessories that cater to your lifestyle.

3. Portability: Keep your MacBook Air safe on the go

If you plan to commute or travel with your MacBook, a protective sleeve is essential in addition to a case. I suggest getting a bag if you wish to carry your accessories along with the MacBook. Ensure the sleeve or bag size is not too big or small for good protection.

4. Durability: Invest in high-quality accessories

A MacBook Air is a premium device, so it makes sense to invest in high-quality accessories that last. A rugged case like the MOSISO hardshell case is ideal for heavy-duty protection.

Check the build quality and material of the products to get an idea of their durability. I read the reviews to learn about the product’s real-life performance. Moreover, you must look at the warranty provided to protect your investment.

5. Budget: Find the right balance between cost and value

MacBook accessories range from budget–friendly options to premium, high-end products. While it’s tempting to go for the cheapest choice, investing in quality accessories can save you money in the long run.

If you’re on a tight budget, affordable yet reliable options like the Anker USB hub or the Fintie sleeve offer great value for money. Before making a purchase, consider how often you’ll use an accessory and whether it justifies the cost.

6. Aesthetics: Personalize your MacBook Air experience

Finally, your accessories should reflect your style and personality. If you love a clean, minimalist setup, accessories like the Apple Magic Keyboard and AirPods Pro will seamlessly blend into your Apple ecosystem. Gamers and those who need a more ergonomic setup might prefer the Logitech keyboard and mouse combo.

Ultimately, choosing the best MacBook Air accessories depends on your personal needs and lifestyle. Now, let’s explore the top options to maximize your MacBook Air experience.

10+ Must-have accessories for M4 MacBook Air

Now that you have sorted your requirements, here are my top-rated recommendations. Remember that the M4 MacBook Air comes in two variations: 13-inch and 15–inch. Also, some accessories are only compatible with M4, M3, and M2 MacBook Air, and may have a different model for M1 MacBook Air.

Best MacBook Air cases for ultimate protection

A protective case is essential for keeping your MacBook Air safe from scratches, dents, and accidental drops. If you’re looking for a perfect fit that maintains the MacBook’s sleek design, the Incase dots hardshell case is a minimalist yet effective choice. It looks transparent but has a subtle textured dot design for scratch resistance.

For those who need heavy-duty protection, the MOSISO geometric hardshell case provides shock absorption and a reinforced exterior with beveled ridges. Its corner protectors and TPU bumpers keep your MacBook safe when carried in a backpack. You also get a keyboard cover with it.

If style is just as important as protection, the JGOO slim and stylish cover offers aesthetic appeal without compromising on durability. The plastic hardshell prevents fingerprints, scratches, drops, and smudges. The brand also offers different prints so choose according to your style.

Additionally, if you’re getting an M4 MacBook Air case that doesn’t bundle a keyboard protector, you should buy one. The UPPERCASE GhostCover keyboard protector is a must-have to prevent dust, spills, and wear from constant typing. It uses tinted TPU material, so it won’t turn yellow after use.

MacBook Air screen protectors to shield your display

A screen protector ensures your new M4 MacBook Air display remains pristine while preventing fingerprints, glare, and scratches. If you want an ultra-clear hard screen protector, the Spigen tempered glass protector is a great choice. Its oleophobic coating reduces fingerprint smudges and prevents dust from settling on your screen.

As I work long hours on my MacBook, I prefer using the FILMEXT anti-glare matte protector. It helps reduce eye strain by softening harsh light reflections and blocking the blue lights. If you frequently work in public spaces and need privacy, the F FORITO privacy screen protector ensures that only you can view your screen. It also has an anti-blue light filter and UV protection.

Tip

To keep your screen dust-free and smudge-free, invest in a cleaning kit like the Tassmpitor keyboard cleaner and screen wipe kit. Learn the right techniques from our guide on how to clean a MacBook screen without damaging it.

Best sleeves and bags for carrying your MacBook Air safely

If you’re always on the move, a protective sleeve or bag is a must-have for safe transportation. First, I will suggest a multi-functional sleeve – the Fintie sleeve case. It’s sleek and has a soft microfiber inside and synthetic leather exterior. Moreover, the sleeve doubles as a stand for ergonomic use. You can also use your mouse on its flip pad.

For those who need a sturdy, lightweight shoulder bag, the tomtoc protective bag is a good choice for professionals and commuters. It has CornerArmor technology and a waterproof exterior to protect your Mac in every condition. The sleeves come in different sizes. So, you can also use this accessory with your 15″ MacBook Air.

Students or professionals who carry multiple items in their bags may prefer the Matein laptop backpack for additional storage. It is lightweight, sturdy, and has an anti-theft compartment. When traveling, you can also use its baggage strap to link it with your suitcases or trolley.

If you want a fashionable alternative, the Canvaslife waterproof shoulder bag offers style and practicality in one. I love its different prints in vibrant colors. The bag is slim yet has many storage pockets for your other accessories.

MacBook Air stands to boost ergonomics and desk organization

A laptop stand improves posture and makes your work setup more ergonomic. If you want a compact, space-saving solution, the UGREEN Vertical Laptop Stand is perfect for storing your MacBook Air when not in use. It has a silicone base at the bottom to prevent your MacBook from slipping. I prefer using this stand in the office when using my Mac in clamshell mode.

For adjustable height and better airflow, the Lamicall adjustable laptop stand provides a comfortable viewing angle while keeping your laptop cool. The aluminum alloy base holds the MacBook properly. Moreover, you can fold the stand and carry it with you.

Connectivity needs – Chargers, USB hubs, and docks

MacBook Air’s limited ports can be a challenge especially if you work with a whole setup of external monitors, SSD, and other peripherals. Therefore, a USB hub or docking station is essential.

The Anker 5-in-1 USB-C hub offers essential ports for everyday use, while the Acer 7-in-1 USB hub provides even more options. Both support 4K 30Hz HDMI, 5Gbps data transfers, and 100W Max power delivery. If you need maximum connectivity, the TobenONE docking station is ideal. It has additional ports, Ethernet support, and dual-monitor compatibility.

To power up your setup without extra cable mess, you need a fast-charging multi-port adapter. The Satechi 165W USB-C charger ensures your devices stay powered with 4 USB-C ports.

Additional accessories for creatives and professional

Looking for a reliable headset for taking calls and gaming? The Logitech Zone Vibe 100 headset provides crisp audio and a noise-canceling mic. Its 18 hours of talk time are perfect for work-from-home professionals. For an all-around premium audio experience, you should go for the Apple AirPods Pro 2. It has advanced features with active noise cancellation.

If you type a lot, an external keyboard and mouse can greatly enhance productivity. The Apple Magic Keyboard is perfect for Apple enthusiasts who prefer a seamless Mac experience. For a combo option, the Logitech keyboard & vertical mouse set is designed for long working hours.

Lastly, if your work requires you to store large files or backups, a portable SSD is a must. The SanDisk 4TB Extreme Portable SSD offers fast data transfers and durability, making it a reliable option for photographers, video editors, and professionals.

Signing off

These are all my recommendations! No matter which MacBook Air model you own—M4, M3, M2, or M1—these accessories will keep your laptop safe, efficient, and ready for anything. Which Mac accessory is a must-have for you? Let me know in the comments below!

@graph.description: Jignesh Padhiyar is the co-founder of iGeeksBlog.com, who has a keen eye for news, rumors, and all the unusual stuff around Apple products. During his tight schedule, Jignesh finds some moments of respite to share side-splitting content on social media.

@graph.name: Incase Dots Hardshell MacBook Air Case
@graph.description: If you’re looking for a perfect fit that maintains the MacBook’s sleek design, the Incase dots hardshell case is a minimalist yet effective choice. It looks transparent but has a subtle textured dot design for scratch resistance.

@graph.name: MOSISO Geometric Heavy Duty Hard Case
@graph.description: The MOSISO geometric hardshell case provides shock absorption and a reinforced exterior with beveled ridges. Its corner protectors and TPU bumpers keep your MacBook safe when carried in a backpack. You also get a keyboard cover with it.

@graph.name: G JGOO Abstract Hard Shell Case
@graph.description: If style is just as important as protection, the JGOO slim and stylish cover offers aesthetic appeal without compromising on durability. The plastic hardshell prevents fingerprints, scratches, drops, and smudges.

@graph.name: UPPERCASE GhostCover Keyboard Protector
@graph.description: The UPPERCASE GhostCover keyboard protector is a must-have to prevent dust, spills, and wear from constant typing. It uses tinted TPU material, so it won’t turn yellow after use.

@graph.name: Spigen Tempered Glass Screen Protector
@graph.description: If you want an ultra-clear hard screen protector, the Spigen tempered glass protector is a great choice. Its oleophobic coating reduces fingerprint smudges and prevents dust from settling on your screen.

@graph.name: FILMEXT Anti-Glare-Matte Screen Protector
@graph.description: As I work long hours on my MacBook, I prefer using the FILMEXT anti-glare matte protector. It helps reduce eye strain by softening harsh light reflections and blocking the blue lights.

@graph.name: F FORITO Magnetic Privacy Screen Protector
@graph.description: If you frequently work in public spaces and need privacy, the F FORITO privacy screen protector ensures that only you can view your screen. It also has an anti-blue light filter and UV protection.

@graph.name: Tassmpitor Laptop Cleaning Kit
@graph.description: To keep your screen dust-free and smudge-free, invest in a cleaning kit like the Tassmpitor keyboard cleaner and screen wipe kit.

@graph.name: Fintie Sleeve Case for MacBook Air
@graph.description: It’s sleek and has a soft microfiber inside and a synthetic leather exterior. Moreover, the sleeve doubles as a stand for ergonomic use. You can also use your mouse on its flip pad.

@graph.name: tomtoc 360 Protective Laptop Shoulder Bag
@graph.description: For those who need a sturdy, lightweight shoulder bag, the tomtoc protective bag is a good choice for professionals and commuters. It has CornerArmor technology and a waterproof exterior to protect your Mac in every condition.

@graph.name: MATEIN Travel Laptop Backpack
@graph.description: Students or professionals who carry multiple items in their bags may prefer the Matein laptop backpack for additional storage. It is lightweight, sturdy, and has an anti-theft compartment.

@graph.name: Canvaslife Waterproof Laptop Shoulder Bag
@graph.description: If you want a fashionable alternative, the Canvaslife waterproof shoulder bag offers style and practicality in one. I love its different prints in vibrant colors. The bag is slim yet has many storage pockets for your other accessories.

@graph.name: UGREEN Vertical Laptop Stand Holder
@graph.description: If you want a compact, space-saving solution, the UGREEN Vertical Laptop Stand is perfect for storing your MacBook Air when not in use. It has a silicone base at the bottom to prevent your MacBook from slipping.

@graph.name: Lamicall Adjustable Laptop Stand
@graph.description: For adjustable height and better airflow, the Lamicall adjustable laptop stand provides a comfortable viewing angle while keeping your laptop cool. The aluminum alloy base holds the MacBook properly.

@graph.name: Anker 5-in-1 USB Hub
@graph.description: Experience comprehensive connectivity featuring a Power Delivery input, two USB-A 2.0 ports, a USB-A 3.0 port, and an HDMI port. Achieve optimal charging with 90W pass-through power to your laptop, supported by a total input of 100W, with the hub reserving 10W for operational efficiency.

@graph.name: Acer 7 in 1 Multi-Port USB C Hub
@graph.description: Acer USBC adapter MacBook is made of Aluminum material, expands a USB-C port to 7 ports. The USB C multiport adapter features Type C fast charge PD port to provide up to 100W of high-speed charging for laptops. The USB C dongle adapter crafted with a high-quality aluminum housing for enhanced durability and heat dissipation.

@graph.name: TobenONE 18-in-2 MacBook Docking Station
@graph.description: If you need maximum connectivity, the TobenONE docking station is ideal. It has additional ports, Ethernet support, and dual-monitor compatibility.

@graph.name: Satechi 165W USB-C 4-Port GaN Charging Station
@graph.description: To power up your setup without extra cable mess, you need a fast-charging multi-port adapter. The Satechi 165W USB-C charger ensures your devices stay powered with 4 USB-C ports.

@graph.name: Logitech Zone Vibe 100 Over Ear Headphones
@graph.description: The Logitech Zone Vibe 100 headset provides crisp audio and a noise-canceling mic. Its 18 hours of talk time are perfect for work-from-home professionals.

@graph.name: Apple AirPods Pro 2
@graph.description: For an all-around premium audio experience, you should go for the Apple AirPods Pro 2. It has advanced features with active noise cancellation.

@graph.name: Apple Magic Keyboard with Numeric Keypad
@graph.description: The Apple Magic Keyboard is perfect for Apple enthusiasts who prefer a seamless Mac experience.

@graph.name: Logitech MX Keys Keyboard & Vertical Mouse Set
@graph.description: The 57-degree angle of Lift for Mac places your hand in a natural handshake position, MX Keys Mini for Mac’s minimalist layout improves your upper body posture

@graph.name: SanDisk 4TB Extreme PRO Portable SSD
@graph.description: The SanDisk 4TB Extreme Portable SSD offers fast data transfers and durability, making it a reliable option for photographers, video editors, and professionals.

title.rendered: How to Make a Group Chat on Snapchat

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Snapchat Group Chats support up to 200 people and allow sharing Snaps, texts, voice notes, and calls, with messages auto-deleting after 24 hours.
  • Creating a group is fast and easy—just select friends, name the group, and start chatting right from the main Snapchat screen.
  • You can customize group settings like name, members, and notifications; Snapchat Plus users can also set custom wallpapers.
  • Group membership and alerts are flexible—anyone can add or remove people, and you can mute or personalize notifications anytime.
  • Leaving is simple if needed by tapping the three-dot menu in the chat and selecting ‘Leave Group’ to exit the conversation.

Let’s be honest: not all Snapchat users are on the platform for Snap Streaks; thus, sending the same Snap to multiple friends can be a pain for such users. That’s exactly why Snapchat group chats exist. By creating a Snapchat group chat, you can put all your friends in one conversation, making it easier to share Snaps, drop texts, or even jump into a spontaneous group call.

Here’s everything you need to know about creating, using, and managing group chats on Snapchat from an iPhone or Android device.

Table of Contents
  • What Is a Snapchat Group Chat?
  • How to Create a Group Chat on Snapchat
  • Customizing Your Snapchat Group
    • Change Group Name
    • Add or Remove People
    • Manage Notifications
    • Set Custom Wallpaper (Snapchat Plus)
  • How to Leave a Group Chat on Snapchat
  • Bring Everyone Together in a Snap

What Is a Snapchat Group Chat?

A Snapchat Group Chat lets you communicate with multiple friends at once in a single conversation. You can send Snaps, text messages, Bitmojis, voice notes, stickers, and even video call everyone — all within one group.

Each group can have up to 200 members, and messages sent in the group are automatically deleted after 24 hours (unless saved).

How to Create a Group Chat on Snapchat

Creating a group chat on Snapchat is as easy as starting a new conversation on the platform. All you need to do is select friends, give the group a name, and you’re done. Here are the detailed steps to create a group chat on Snapchat:

  1. Open the Snapchat app, and swipe on the Camera tab or tap the speech bubble icon at the bottom to access the Chat feed.
  2. Here, tap the pencil-and-paper icon (New Conversation) at the bottom right corner to start a new conversation.
  3. Now, tap the New Group tab, give it a name, and select the friends you want to add to your group. You can add up to 200 friends.

  4. Once done, tap the Chat with Group to start a group chat on Snapchat.

Your Snapchat group chat is now live; you and other group members can start sending snaps and messages.

Customizing Your Snapchat Group

Once you’ve created or are part of a Snapchat group chat, you can personalize it to your preference. Unlike WhatsApp, there is no Admin concept in Snapchat group chats; therefore, any group member can make changes according to their preferences.

That said, here’s how you can customize and manage a group chat on Snapchat:

Change Group Name

While Snapchat asks you to name your group chat when creating it, there may come a time when the current name no longer suits you, or other members don’t like it. Fortunately, changing the group name is super easy; here’s how:

  1. Open the group chat and tap the group’s Bitmoji icon or name at the top.
  2. Here, tap the group name, enter the new name in the pop-up window that appears, and hit Save.

Add or Remove People

Friendships are dynamic — sometimes you make new friends, and old ones fade away. Therefore, it becomes necessary to add new people to the group chat and remove the ones you and other group members are no longer friends with. And with no Admin role in the Snapchat group chat, anyone can add or remove people at any time. Here’s how:

To Add Members:

  1. Open the group chat and tap the group’s Bitmoji icon or name at the top.

  2. Here, tap the three-dot button (More Options) at the top right corner, then select the Add Group Members option in the pop-up menu.
  3. Select the friends you want to add to the group and tap Done.

To Remove Members:

  1. Open the group chat and tap the group’s Bitmoji icon or name at the top.
  2. Tap and hold the group member’s name you want to remove under the Group Members section.

  3. Tap Remove from Group, then tap Remove button to confirm.

Manage Notifications

Yes, a group chat is a great way to connect with multiple people at once, but sometimes, numerous incoming notifications at once can disrupt your workflow. Luckily, Snapchat offers the option to turn off particular types of notifications while keeping the others on. For example, you can turn off Chats and Snaps notifications and keep Mentions Only notifications enabled.

Here’s how you can do this:

  1. Open the group chat and tap the group’s Bitmoji icon or name at the top.
  2. Tap the three-dot button (More Options) at the top right corner.
  3. Select the Chat & Notification Settings option in the pop-up menu.
  4. Tap Chat Notifications and select the appropriate option.
  5. Additionally, you can also Mute Calls, change Notification Sound and Ringtone, Mute Chats, and more.

Set Custom Wallpaper (Snapchat Plus)

Users with a Snapchat Plus subscription can take the group chat personalization to the next level. They can add custom chat backgrounds to the group chat, similar to how you add a background in an iMessage group chat. Here’s how:

  1. Open the group chat and tap the group’s Bitmoji icon or name at the top.
  2. Tap on Wallpaper under the Our Chat section.
  3. Now, choose one of the premade wallpapers, upload one from your camera roll, or use Snapchat AI to create a wallpaper using text prompts.

How to Leave a Group Chat on Snapchat

There comes a time when you no longer wish to be a part of a group chat on Snapchat. Luckily, leaving a Snapchat group chat is pretty easy.

  1. Open the group chat and tap the group’s Bitmoji icon or name.
  2. Tap the three-dot button at the top right corner.
  3. Choose the Leave Group option in the pop-up menu, then tap the Leave button to confirm.

Bring Everyone Together in a Snap

Snapchat group chats are a great way to bring your friends together for fun conversations, making plans, or sharing life’s random moments. With just a few taps, you can create your own group chat and chat with multiple friends at once.

keyPoints.title: What Is a Snapchat Group Chat?
keyPoints.explanation: A Snapchat Group Chat allows multiple friends to communicate together by sharing Snaps, texts, voice notes, and video calls, with up to 200 members, and messages disappear after 24 hours unless saved.

keyPoints.title: How to Create a Snapchat Group Chat
keyPoints.explanation: Starting a group chat involves opening Snapchat, selecting friends, naming the group, and then sending messages, making it simple to gather multiple friends in one conversation.

keyPoints.title: Customizing Your Snapchat Group
keyPoints.explanation: You can personalize group chats by changing the group name, adding or removing members, managing notifications, and, for Snapchat Plus users, setting custom wallpapers to enhance the chat experience.

keyPoints.title: Managing Group Members and Notifications
keyPoints.explanation: Anyone can add or remove members from the group chat, and you can also control notification settings to mute or customize alerts for a less disruptive experience.

keyPoints.title: Leaving a Snapchat Group Chat
keyPoints.explanation: If you wish to exit a group chat, simply open the chat, tap the three-dot menu, and select 'Leave Group' to exit gracefully.

title.rendered: How to Cancel Roblox Premium Subscription on Any Device

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Key Cancellation Rules: Cancel based on your purchase platform; benefits last until the billing cycle ends with no refunds.
  • Cancel on Web Browser: To cancel via a web browser, log into your account and go to Settings > Subscriptions.
  • Cancel on Apple Devices: On iPhone/iPad, cancel in Settings > Subscriptions. On Mac, use the App Store’s account settings.
  • Cancel on Android: On Android devices, cancel your subscription directly through the Google Play Store’s “Payments & Subscriptions” menu.
  • Windows/Amazon Users: Subscriptions from the Windows or Amazon stores are non-renewing, so no cancellation action is required.

Roblox Premium gives you extra Robux every month, lets you trade items, and unlocks special features in the game. It’s ideal if you play often and take advantage of those exclusive benefits.

But if you’re not using it much or it’s no longer worth the monthly cost, you might want to cancel. The tricky part is that Roblox doesn’t make it super straightforward. How you cancel depends on where you originally purchased the subscription, whether through the iPhone app, browser, or Android device.

This guide breaks it all down step by step, no matter which device you used to subscribe.

Table of Contents
  • Important Things to Know Before Canceling Roblox Premium
  • How to Cancel If You Bought Roblox Premium on a Browser (Mac/Windows)
  • How to Cancel If You Subscribed via the App Store (iPhone, iPad, or Mac)
  • How to Cancel If You Subscribed via the Google Play Store (Android)
  • Canceling Roblox Premium via Windows Store or Amazon Appstore
  • What About Xbox, PlayStation, or Meta Quest?
  • Can't Find the Cancel Button for Roblox Premium?
  • Having Trouble Logging In or Canceling Roblox Premium?
  • Avoid Getting Charged Again for Roblox Premium
Note You can only cancel Roblox Premium from the same platform you used to purchase it, such as a browser, Google Play, or Apple ID.

Important Things to Know Before Canceling Roblox Premium

Before you cancel, here’s what you should know:

  • If you’re in a Family Sharing group, only the person who purchased Premium can cancel it.
  • Cancel at least 24 hours before renewal to avoid being charged again.
  • You’ll retain Premium benefits until the current paid period ends.
  • Roblox doesn’t offer refunds for canceled memberships.
  • You can’t transfer Premium benefits, Robux, or items to another account.
  • If you want to resubscribe later, you’ll need to wait until the current subscription fully expires.

How to Cancel If You Bought Roblox Premium on a Browser (Mac/Windows)

This method applies if you purchased Roblox Premium directly through the Roblox website using a browser on Windows or Mac. It’s one of the easiest ways to manage your subscription.

  1. Open Roblox website on the browser
  2. Log in to the account with the Premium subscription.
  3. Click the gear icon in the top-right corner.
  4. Go to Settings > Subscriptions.
  5. Click your Premium Membership (it appears at the top if active).
  6. Click Cancel Renewal and follow the prompts.

Once canceled, the subscription will not renew, but you’ll continue to enjoy Premium benefits until your current billing cycle ends.

How to Cancel If You Subscribed via the App Store (iPhone, iPad, or Mac)

Roblox Premium subscriptions bought through the App Store are tied to your Apple ID. You can cancel from any Apple device as long as you’re signed in with the same Apple ID used for the purchase.

To cancel on iPhone or iPad:

  1. Open the Settings app.
  2. Tap your name > Subscriptions.
  3. Select Roblox.
  4. Tap Cancel Subscription and confirm.

To cancel on Mac:

  1. Open the App Store on Mac.
  2. Click your name > Account Settings.
  3. Scroll to Subscriptions > Manage.
  4. Click Edit next to Roblox > Cancel Subscription.

The subscription will remain active until the end of the current billing cycle. Make sure to cancel before the renewal date to avoid being charged again.

How to Cancel If You Subscribed via the Google Play Store (Android)

If you subscribed through the Android app, your Premium plan is managed via your Google Play billing account. Make sure you’re logged into the correct Google account before proceeding.

To cancel using Google Play:

  1. Open the Google Play Store.
  2. Tap your profile icon > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions.
  3. Select Roblox Premium.
  4. Tap Cancel Subscription, then confirm.

To cancel from the Roblox app:

  1. Open the Roblox app, log in with the same account.
  2. Tap the gear icon > Settings > Subscriptions.
  3. Tap Cancel Renewal and follow the steps.

After canceling, you will still receive Premium benefits until the end of your billing period. No further charges will occur unless you manually resubscribe.

Canceling Roblox Premium via Windows Store or Amazon Appstore

Roblox subscriptions purchased via the Windows Store or Amazon Appstore are one-time, non-renewing memberships. They expire automatically at the end of the month, so there’s nothing to cancel.

If you’re unsure where you made the purchase, check your billing history or go to Settings > Billing on the Roblox app or website.

If you also want to get started with voice chat on Roblox, check out our guide How to Get Voice Chat on Roblox.

What About Xbox, PlayStation, or Meta Quest?

Roblox Premium is not available for purchase on Xbox, PlayStation, or Meta Quest. You also cannot cancel or manage subscriptions on these platforms. To make changes, use the device where you originally bought the subscription.

Can’t Find the Cancel Button for Roblox Premium?

Here are some possible reasons:

  • You’re logged into the wrong account.
  • You’re trying to cancel on a platform that wasn’t used for the purchase.
  • The membership already expired or was previously canceled.
  • Your payment method doesn’t support automatic renewal.
  • The membership is currently in the process of renewing, so you may need to wait for it to complete or fail.

Having Trouble Logging In or Canceling Roblox Premium?

If you’re unable to log in or don’t remember which account has Premium, contact Roblox Support. Include helpful details such as:

  • Payment method used (e.g., card, PayPal)
  • Billing or PayPal email address
  • Last 4 digits of the card
  • Amount and date of your most recent payment

You can also email info@roblox.com, which routes to the same support system. Be sure to contact them before your renewal date for the best chance at resolving the issue.

Avoid Getting Charged Again for Roblox Premium

Canceling Roblox Premium is easy once you know where to look. Just remember to cancel using the same platform where you made the purchase and do it before the renewal date. If you’re done with Premium for now, you’re not alone. Now you know exactly how to cancel it without the stress.

@graph.name: How to Cancel Roblox Premium on a Browser
@graph.description: Cancel your Roblox Premium membership purchased via a web browser by managing your subscription in account settings.

step.name: Open Roblox website
step.text: Go to the Roblox website in your preferred browser.

itemListElement.text: Launch your web browser.
Navigate to roblox.com.

step.name: Log in to your Roblox account
step.text: Sign in to the account that has the active Premium subscription.

itemListElement.text: Enter your Roblox username and password.
Click Log In.

step.name: Access account settings
step.text: Click the gear icon in the top-right corner and go to Settings.

itemListElement.text: Locate the gear icon in the upper right.
Click it and select Settings.

step.name: Go to subscriptions
step.text: Select Subscriptions from the settings menu to view your active memberships.

itemListElement.text: Click Subscriptions in the left-hand menu.

step.name: Select your Premium Membership
step.text: If active, your Premium Membership will appear at the top of the list. Click on it.

itemListElement.text: Locate your Premium Membership in the list.
Click to open its details.

step.name: Cancel your subscription
step.text: Click Cancel Renewal and follow the prompts to complete the cancellation process.

itemListElement.text: Click Cancel Renewal.
Confirm your choice by following the on-screen prompts.

@graph.name: How to Cancel Roblox Premium via the App Store
@graph.description: Cancel your Roblox Premium subscription purchased through the App Store by managing it in your iPhone settings.

supply.name: iPhone or iPad with Roblox Premium subscription

step.name: Open Settings app
step.text: On your iPhone or iPad, launch the Settings app from the home screen.

itemListElement.text: Locate the Settings app icon.
Tap to open it.

step.name: Go to Subscriptions
step.text: Tap your name at the top of Settings, then select Subscriptions.

itemListElement.text: Tap your Apple ID banner at the top.
Select Subscriptions from the menu.

step.name: Select Roblox subscription
step.text: Find Roblox in the list of active subscriptions and tap on it.

itemListElement.text: Scroll through your subscriptions.
Tap Roblox to open its details.

step.name: Cancel the subscription
step.text: Tap Cancel Subscription and confirm your choice when prompted.

itemListElement.text: Tap Cancel Subscription.
Confirm cancellation in the pop-up prompt.

step.name: Open Google Play Store
step.text: Launch the Google Play Store app on your Android device.

itemListElement.text: Locate the Google Play Store icon.
Tap to open it.

step.name: Go to Subscriptions
step.text: Tap your profile icon, then select Payments & subscriptions, and tap Subscriptions.

itemListElement.text: Tap your profile icon in the top-right corner.
Select Payments & subscriptions.
Tap Subscriptions.

step.name: Select Roblox Premium
step.text: Find Roblox Premium in the list of active subscriptions and tap on it.

itemListElement.text: Scroll through your subscriptions list.
Tap Roblox Premium to open its details.

keyPoints.title: Roblox Premium Benefits and Cancellation Considerations
keyPoints.explanation: Roblox Premium offers monthly Robux, trading, and exclusive features, but cancellation depends on where you purchased it, and benefits last until the current billing cycle ends with no refunds.

keyPoints.title: Canceling Roblox Premium via Web Browser
keyPoints.explanation: To cancel on a browser, log into your Roblox account, access Settings > Subscriptions, select your Premium membership, and click 'Cancel Renewal'.

keyPoints.title: Canceling Roblox Premium through Apple Devices
keyPoints.explanation: On iPhone or iPad, go to Settings > Subscriptions to cancel, whereas on Mac, use the App Store > Account Settings > Subscriptions; cancel before renewal to avoid charges.

keyPoints.title: Managing Cancellation on Android
keyPoints.explanation: Use Google Play Store > Payments & Subscriptions > Subscriptions to cancel Roblox Premium, or through the app by navigating to Settings > Subscriptions and tapping 'Cancel Renewal'.

keyPoints.title: Subscriptions on Windows Store or Amazon Appstore and Other Platforms
keyPoints.explanation: Subscriptions bought via Windows Store or Amazon are non-renewing and expire automatically; no cancellation is necessary, but verify billing history for confirmation.

title.rendered: 11 Best Roblox Games to Play With Friends

content.rendered:
You know that feeling when you’re on a call with friends, scrolling through Roblox, trying to find something that isn’t a broken obby or yet another tycoon? We’ve all been there. Instead of wasting another hour on the Discover page, this roundup highlights some of the best Roblox games to play with friends, the ones that are actually fun, well-made, and perfect for chaotic voice chat moments.

These aren’t listed in any ranked order, because each one hits differently depending on the mood. Let’s dive in.

Table of Contents
  • 1. Roblox Party
  • 2. Outlaster
  • 3. Slap Battles
  • 4. Jailbreak
  • 5. Rail Frenzy
  • 6. Chained Together
  • 7. Together
  • 8. Pull a Friend
  • 9. Survive the Killer
  • 10. Lost Rooms
  • 11. Fleets
  • Final Thoughts

1. Roblox Party

Think of it like Mario Party in Roblox form. Up to 10 people can join the same board and take turns rolling dice to move through tile events, earn coins, and win mini-games. It has a proper party mode where you can land on lucky tiles, visit item shops, or sabotage others, all while playing a random set of mini-games each round.

Seasonal events bring in new boards and cosmetics too, so it’s the kind of game you can revisit during holidays. It’s straightforward, fun, and a perfect pick when your entire friend group wants something casual but competitive.

2. Outlaster

Outlaster drops you into a survival game show where you and your friends complete challenges, form alliances, and vote each other out. There are different modes—Classic, Voice Chat, and All-Stars, and even if you get eliminated early, you can end up in a Redemption round with a shot to return. Hidden around the map are “advantages” that work like immunity idols—you can block votes or even steal someone else’s.

The final winner is chosen by a jury of voted-out players, so playing socially matters just as much as being good at challenges. It’s perfect for friend groups that love strategy, drama, and chaos.

Also read: Best Scary Roblox Games to Play Right Now

3. Slap Battles

Slap Battles is chaos, but with rules. You start with basic gloves and unlock more by either racking up slaps or completing unique badge challenges. Some gloves let you shoot lasers, reverse gravity, or even teleport.

Public lobbies are madness, but private servers are great for testing gloves and helping friends unlock the harder ones. There are also limited-time gloves and seasonal codes, so if your group is into grinding or discovering new mechanics together, this one sticks.

4. Jailbreak

Jailbreak has been around for years, and it’s still one of the most polished cops vs. robbers games on Roblox. Criminals plan and execute heists at different locations like the casino, museum, and power plant, each one with a unique puzzle to crack. Cops can chase them, block escapes, and use upgraded gear and vehicles.

The game constantly adds new objectives, seasonal rewards, and contract missions that give your group something to focus on together. Whether you’re coordinating a multi-car escape or setting up a roadblock, there’s always something to do as a team.

5. Rail Frenzy

Rail Frenzy is like Overcooked with trains. You and your squad work together to lay down tracks for a constantly moving train. You chop wood, mine stone, craft tracks, build bridges, and keep the engine cool with water buckets. As you progress, biomes get tougher and require new strategies. Between rounds, you can spend earned gears on better wagons and upgrades, like faster crafters or extra storage.

Some levels throw in bonus objectives too, like building extra bridges for rewards. It’s the kind of game where everyone has a role, and teamwork is everything.

Like to read: How to follow someone on Roblox

6. Chained Together

In this game, you’re literally chained to your friends and trying to climb out of a pit filled with tricky platforms and hazards. One player can anchor while the other swings, and you’ll need to coordinate jumps, manage momentum, and react quickly to moving platforms or rotating traps. It supports up to 6 players and has become popular for group challenge runs.

A single mistake resets your whole group, which makes finishing a level feel extra satisfying. If your group likes testing patience and precision together, this one’s a blast.

7. Together

Together is a side-scrolling co-op game where every player has to pull their weight, because if one person fails, everyone resets the level. The game uses pressure plates, trap triggers, and multi-stage puzzles, so you’ll be switching roles constantly. Some people scout, some hold switches, others do the risky jumps.

There’s no time pressure, so you can go at your own pace, but your team’s success depends on clear communication. It’s a game that exposes who trolls, who carries, and who panics under pressure.

8. Pull a Friend

This one’s a two-player-only game that’s perfect when you’re just hanging out with one close friend. One player rides in a cart and controls the brakes, while the other pulls them through obstacle-filled courses. You’ll navigate ramps, tight corners, and gaps, learning how to control the physics and momentum of the rope-cart system.

There are upgrades for brake strength and cart durability, which help you tackle tougher tracks later. It’s simple but well-designed, and a great game when you want something light and funny.

9. Survive the Killer

This is classic hide-and-seek with a horror twist. One player becomes the killer while the rest hide, revive teammates, and try to escape. Matches start with a short planning phase, then the killer gets full control. You earn XP and coins based on performance, which unlock new killers, perks, and cosmetic knives.

It’s fun with friends because you can body block for saves, split roles (some hide, some rescue), and clutch escapes in voice chat. Each round only lasts about five minutes, so it’s great for quick sessions.

10. Lost Rooms

Lost Rooms throws you into a chain of eerie, randomly generated rooms. Some are quiet and safe, others contain monsters or hazards. You rely on flashlights and callouts, and it’s best played in a group of 3–5 so everyone can take a role—like scout, rear guard, or navigator.

The audio design is sharp, and limited lighting creates real tension. It’s not a fast game, but the unpredictability and creeping horror make every run feel different.

11. Fleets

Fleets is a one-on-one turn-based strategy game where you and a friend build custom fleets of 10 ships. Each ship can be tuned for durability, speed, range, or attack. Once the battle starts, it’s all about outmaneuvering your opponent, using positioning, movement, and prediction more than just raw firepower. If you enjoy games like chess or Advance Wars, this one rewards smart plays and long-term planning. Great for competitive duos who want something slower and more tactical.

Final Thoughts

All these games offer different ways to play together, whether you’re competing, surviving, solving, or just messing around. And that’s what makes them stand out. They don’t just support multiplayer; they’re designed to bring out the best (and sometimes worst) in your group. So next time you’re hanging out, and someone asks what to play, just pick one of these. You’ll be set.

title.rendered: How to Delete Frequently Visited Sites on iPhone, iPad, and Mac

content.rendered:
Having quick access to the websites you frequently visit is useful, as it saves time without requiring you to bookmark each one. However, while Apple designed the Frequently Visited section for convenience, it can quickly become cluttered or expose sites you would prefer to keep private, especially on shared devices. Safari now groups these websites under the Suggestions section alongside websites Shared with You. That said, if you want to remove individual sites or hide the section entirely, you have full control over this section.
 
This post covers everything you need to know about Frequently Visited websites in Safari.

Table of Contents
  • What Are the Frequently Visited Sites in Safari?
  • How to Remove Frequently Visited Sites on Your iPhone's Safari
    • Remove a Single Site from Frequently Visited
    • Hide the Frequently Visited Section Completely
    • Remove All Frequently Visited Sites at Once
  • How to Remove Frequently Visited Sites on Your Mac's Safari
    • Remove Individual Frequently Visited Sites
    • Hide the Frequently Visited Section Completely
    • Clear Safari History to Reset Frequently Visited
  • What Happens When You Clear Your Safari History?
  • Why Do Deleted Websites Sometimes Reappear?
  • Best Practices for Privacy and a Cleaner Start Page
  • A Cleaner Safari Start Page…

What Are the Frequently Visited Sites in Safari?

Because Safari keeps a record of your browsing activity, it automatically surfaces the websites you visit most often as large thumbnail shortcuts on the Safari Start Page. These shortcuts are generated based on your usage patterns and update over time.

Previously, Safari displayed Frequently Visited websites in a dedicated section. Apple has now moved them into a consolidated Suggestions section on the Safari Start Page.

Most importantly, these are not bookmarks, reading list items, or pinned tabs. Removing them does not delete the website from your browsing history unless you explicitly clear browsing data.

How to Remove Frequently Visited Sites on Your iPhone’s Safari

The Suggestions section, which now combines Frequently Visited websites and Shared with You content, is enabled by default in Safari settings. As a result, Safari automatically displays website shortcuts on the Start Page based on your browsing activity.

Here’s how you can manage or remove these suggestions directly from the Start Page, depending on how much control you want over what appears.

Remove a Single Site from Frequently Visited

If you want a specific website to stop appearing under Suggestions on your Safari Start Page, you can remove it individually instead of disabling the entire section. Here’s how:

  1. Open the Safari app and tap the Tabs icon at the bottom left corner. 
  2. Here, tap the + button at the bottom right corner to open a new Start Page. 
  3. Scroll down to the Suggestions section, and you’ll find all your Frequently Visited websites presented in a swipeable thumbnail view below it. 
  4. Tap and hold the website thumbnail shortcut you want to remove. 
  5. Tap Remove Link on the pop-up menu that appears.

Hide the Frequently Visited Section Completely

If you share your iPhone with your friends and family, and don’t want them to know about the websites you visit often, you can easily hide all the frequently visited website thumbnails from your Safari Start Page at once. Here’s how you can do this:

  1. Open a new tab in Safari.
  2. Scroll down to the bottom and tap the Edit button.
  3. Here, toggle off Frequently Visited under Show in Suggestions.

Remove All Frequently Visited Sites at Once

Hiding the Frequently Visited section may not be sufficient if the person you share your iPhone with knows how to re-enable it. In such cases, clearing your Safari browsing history ensures that no frequently visited website thumbnails appear on the Safari Start Page, even when the section is turned back on.

  1. Go to Settings → Apps → Safari.
  2. Tap Clear History and Clear Website Data under the History and Website Data section.
  3. Next, select All History under Clear Timeframe, then tap the Clear History button.

How to Remove Frequently Visited Sites on Your Mac’s Safari

Like on iPhone, the Safari Start Page on Mac automatically shows websites you visit often. Managing or removing these Frequently Visited shortcuts is straightforward and can be done directly from the Start Page or Safari settings. Here’s how:

Remove Individual Frequently Visited Sites

  1. In Safari, click the + button at the top right corner to open a new tab.
  2. Now, Control-click the website thumbnail you want to remove.
  3. Next, select Remove Link in the contextual menu that appears.

Hide the Frequently Visited Section Completely

  1. Open a new tab in the Safari browser.
  2. Here, click the Edit button at the bottom right corner of the Safari Start Page.
  3. Next, uncheck Frequently Visited under Show in Suggestions.

Clear Safari History to Reset Frequently Visited

  1. With the Safari app open, click History in the menu bar.
  2. Here, click “Clear History” on the drop-down menu.
  3. Next, choose how far back you want your browsing history cleared, then click the Clear History button.

What Happens When You Clear Your Safari History?

When you clear your browsing history, Safari removes records of the websites you have visited along with associated data such as cookies and cached files. As a result, Frequently Visited site suggestions and related shortcuts are temporarily reset and removed from the Start Page.

The downside is that clearing your history also signs you out of websites, removes stored site preferences, and may temporarily affect website load times.

Bookmarks, Reading List items, and saved tabs remain untouched, and browsing-based suggestions are rebuilt over time as you continue using Safari.

Why Do Deleted Websites Sometimes Reappear?

Removing a site from Suggestions does not block Safari from recommending it again. If you continue to visit the same website, Safari may surface it again based on your usage.

To prevent this:

  • Use Private Browsing for sensitive sessions.
  • Clear cookies and website data for specific domains.
  • Keep Suggestions disabled on the Start Page.

Best Practices for Privacy and a Cleaner Start Page

Use these tips to keep your Safari Start Page intentional and privacy-friendly:

  • Remove individual tiles for quick cleanup.
  • Disable Suggestions on shared devices.
  • Use bookmarks instead of relying on auto-surfaced sites.
  • Periodically clear Safari website data.
  • Use Private Browsing for one-off visits.

A Cleaner Safari Start Page…

While Safari’s suggestions for frequently visited websites are helpful, they should work on your terms. Therefore, knowing how to remove individual suggestions, hide the section entirely, or reset Safari’s browsing data helps you keep your browsing habits private and your Start Page clutter-free.

Running into issues or seeing something new in Safari? Tell us about it in the comments below.

FAQs

Why does Safari show frequently visited sites?

Safari analyzes your browsing activity to surface commonly visited websites under the Suggestions section on the Start Page. These thumbnails are meant to provide quick access to sites you open often, based on your recent usage patterns.

Can I turn off frequently visited sites on Safari?

Since frequently visited websites are now part of Suggestions, you can disable them by turning off the Suggestions toggle entirely or by disabling Frequently Visited under Show in Suggestions from Safari’s Start Page edit options.

Will removing frequently visited sites affect my browser history?

Removing a website from Suggestions only removes the thumbnail from the Start Page. Your browsing history, cookies, and saved data remain unchanged unless you manually clear Safari history and website data from settings.

mainEntity.name: Why does Safari show frequently visited sites?

mainEntity.name: Will removing frequently visited sites affect my browser history?

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: Wondershare FamiSafe V9.0 Review: AI-Powered Parental Control Makes Social Media Safety Easier

content.rendered:
Wondershare FamiSafe V9.0 is an AI-powered, all-in-one parental control app designed to help parents identify online risks and foster healthier digital habits for their children.

It starts with a call from the school: your child hasn’t turned in assignments for days. They’ve been eating lunch alone. Teachers say they keep checking their phone, then looking shaken, sometimes leaving class after a single message. When you ask what’s going on, you get the usual “I’m fine.” But the sleepless nights, the sudden secrecy, and visible stress suggest otherwise.

For many parents today, this is how online problems surface: quietly, without clear signs. That’s where tools like FamiSafe come in. Instead of tracking every action, the app gives a clearer sense of whether something needs attention. It’s designed to help parents follow digital behavior without feeling like they’re running surveillance software.

With version 9.0, FamiSafe pushes that idea further. The update focuses on improving how information is captured, interpreted, and delivered, making it one of the most practical updates we’ve seen from the app recently.

Quick Overview of Wondershare FamiSafe

FamiSafe is a parental-control app built to give parents a structured, readable view of what’s happening on their kids’ devices. Its core capabilities include social media monitoring, location tracking, screen-time limits, and activity reports.

What’s New in FamiSafe V9.0: Practical Upgrades That Focus on Context

FamiSafe V9.0 introduces changes that directly affect how parents monitor and interpret digital behavior. Four changes stand out during testing:

  • Broader social media monitoring across 30+ platforms
  • AI-powered content analysis with instant alerts
  • Visual activity dashboard

Together, these updates make the app feel more focused on delivering the information that matters, not just more data.

To see how this plays out, let’s look at each new addition in real-world use. 

1. Expanded Social Media Monitoring

Kids don’t stay in one place online anymore. Conversations jump from TikTok to Instagram to WhatsApp in minutes, and relying on single-app monitoring usually leaves big gaps.

This is where FamiSafe’s expanded coverage in version 9.0 becomes useful. With support for 30+ mainstream social platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, WhatsApp, and YouTube, the app aligns more closely with how kids actually communicate. In testing, we found that FamiSafe could surface risks that would normally be scattered across different apps.

In practice, FamiSafe’s cross-platform detection actively tracks interactions and contextual cues across multiple social apps, bringing everything into one place for a comprehensive view of a child’s digital activity. This is especially valuable for families with kids who jump between various social platforms, allowing for meaningful early insights into potential risks.

By focusing on social media monitoring, FamiSafe helps protect kids from cyberbullying, predatory behavior, and exposure to inappropriate content—key factors that can negatively impact a kid’s well-being. The app detects signs of distress, such as harmful conversations, and alerts parents if their kid is engaging with risky individuals or content. This holistic approach empowers parents to intervene early, ensuring their kids’ mental and emotional safety online.

2. AI-Powered Analysis for Real-Time Risk Alerts

One of the more useful upgrades in FamiSafe is its improved AI-powered risk detection. Instead of flagging every suspicious word, the system now looks at context, how the language is used, whether the tone suggests bullying, and whether similar messages are appearing across different apps.

In testing, this cut down on the noise that usually comes with older parental-control tools. Alerts felt more focused and closer to situations that might actually require attention, rather than a long list of disconnected keywords.
A simplified example shows how this plays out:

A parent noticed their 13-year-old becoming withdrawn, but every attempt to talk ended with a quick “I’m fine.” After enabling FamiSafe, a small number of alerts surfaced for repeated phrases such as “don’t sit with us” and “just leave,” all originating from the same group chat on Instagram. It wasn’t a single rude message; it was a pattern. That early signal provided the parent with enough context to step in before the situation escalated.

The updated AI isn’t perfect, but it’s a meaningful step up for spotting early signs of distress or risk in a kid’s digital activity, such as cyberbullying, predatory behavior, self-harm or suicidal thoughts, exposure to inappropriate content, mood changes, signs of depression, and discussions about risky behaviors, enabling parents to intervene early and protect their kids.

New UI for an Improved User Experience

FamiSafe’s interface aims for clarity over complexity. The dashboard is split into two clear sections: Device Usage and App Usage, making it easy to see when the device was active and how time was spent.

In practice, the interface helps parents quickly spot:

  • screen-time jumps,
  • new habits forming,
  • or any unusual usage patterns.

Everything is color-coded and cleanly organized, so even a quick glance is usually enough to understand what’s going on.

Pricing of FamiSafe

FamiSafe is available on both the App Store and Google Play. For families who need a fuller view, there are three subscription options:

Overall, FamiSafe V9.0 doesn’t reinvent parental controls, but it does make them more practical for today’s multi-platform digital environment. The expanded social media coverage, AI-driven risk detection, and visual dashboard work together to provide parents with clearer, more actionable insights without making monitoring a full-time task.

For families looking for a single tool that balances oversight with usability, FamiSafe V9.0 is a solid step forward. It won’t replace conversations or guidance at home, but it can help parents stay informed, spot early warning signs, and support healthier digital habits for their children.

title.rendered: iPhone Air 2 Could Gain iPhone 17 Pro Cooling and Camera Features

content.rendered:
iPhone Air 2 Could Gain Pro-Level Cooling and Camera Upgrades While the iPhone 17 Pro has been a strong seller, the iPhone Air hasn’t enjoyed the same commercial success, even though many owners speak highly of it. Now, new rumors suggest Apple could change that by bringing two major iPhone 17 Pro features to the upcoming iPhone Air 2, according to new report from The Information.

These potential upgrades focus on performance and photography, two areas that often influence buying decisions. If they arrive as expected, they could give the iPhone Air line a much-needed boost.

Better Cooling Could Unlock Stronger Everyday Performance

One of the most notable upgrades rumored for the iPhone Air 2 is a vapor chamber cooling system, a feature currently found in the iPhone 17 Pro. While cooling technology rarely grabs headlines, its impact can be significant.

Apple designed the vapor chamber to manage heat more efficiently by spreading it across the phone’s aluminum body. This allows the processor to maintain higher performance levels for longer periods without overheating. In practical terms, that means smoother gameplay, faster photo processing, and fewer slowdowns during demanding tasks.

For users who push their phones hard, such as recording high-quality video or using performance-heavy apps, this could make the iPhone Air 2 feel noticeably more reliable than its predecessor.

A Second Rear Camera Could Make the Air More Versatile

Another rumored improvement is the addition of a second rear-facing camera. The current iPhone Air has a single rear camera, which limits its flexibility compared to other models in Apple’s lineup.

Reports suggest the iPhone Air 2 may gain one of the extra cameras found on the iPhone 17 Pro, though it’s not yet clear which one Apple will choose. A second camera would expand shooting options and help the Air better compete with similarly priced smartphones.

This change could appeal to users who enjoy mobile photography but don’t want to pay for a Pro model. Even a single extra lens can significantly improve how versatile a phone feels day to day.

A Chance for the iPhone Air Lineup to Find Its Footing

The original iPhone Air positioned itself as a lightweight device with high-end power, but sales struggled to match expectations. By borrowing proven features from the iPhone 17 Pro, Apple appears to be refining what the Air series stands for.

If these rumors hold true, the iPhone Air 2 could deliver stronger sustained performance and improved camera capabilities without moving into Pro pricing territory. That balance may be exactly what the Air lineup needs to connect with a wider audience.

excerpt.rendered: Apple may bring iPhone 17 Pro-level cooling and camera upgrades to the iPhone Air 2, a move that could fix past shortcomings and revive interest in the Air lineup.
